data: Which of the following is true about the graph on the right side of the figure?

The graph on the right side of the figure shows the BLEU variation between models with different Ke values with respect to reentrancy numbers. The lines represent two different Ke values: Ke=0 (blue line) and Ke=4 (red line). The x-axis represents the range of reentrancy numbers, and the y-axis represents the BLEU score. The graph shows that for both Ke values, the BLEU score decreases as the reentrancy number increases. Additionally, the red line (Ke=4) consistently has a higher BLEU score than the blue line (Ke=0) across all reentrancy number ranges.
